dedupe_keys.name: gneste generation and storage technology costs and performance

description: GNESTE compiles literature-based cost and performance assumptions for coal, gas, hydro, nuclear, photovoltaic and wind generation, plus utility-scale battery storage. The research collaboration records capital and operating costs, fuel prices, efficiency, construction time, lifetime and financing assumptions. Coverage spans 2015–2050 with global, regional and country-specific entries from 56 sources. The Zenodo concept resolves to release 11613350 with CSV and Excel files; the companion GitHub README also states CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. Repository metadata report 5,510 points while the article reports 5,518, so the exact count remains unverified. Heterogeneous sources and future assumptions should not be combined as if they were observed, directly comparable project costs. A reviewer-assessed use is selecting and testing input ranges for energy-system simulations. model-osemosys and model-pypsa are related planning tools. No cells, unit conversions or model runs were checked.
name: GNESTE generation and storage technology costs and performance
notes: G2-0170. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
